description: This file defines an 'EditorPanel' component using LightningJS's Blits library. It manages state related to a note (title, content, summary), and provides methods for saving, regenerating summaries, clearing data, and deleting notes. It also includes a template for rendering the editor interface, styled with themes and connected to a central store for state management.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes, including UI, state management, and interaction methods.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the store for the selected note.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of the content using an external summarize utility.

methods.name: clearOrNew
methods.description: Clears the current note fields or adds a new blank note.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note from the store.
